body.name: \(\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY}}\) (band event-transfer class)
body.construction: \(\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY}}=\{(P_n)_{n\ge1}\in\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY},0}:\mathsf A_{\mathrm{rem}}((P_n);\varepsilon^{\mathrm{rem}})\}\). Equivalently, each finite slice obeys \(\Delta_{\mathrm{CY},n}(K)\sqrt{\log(2K)}\le\varepsilon_n^{\mathrm{rem}}\) for the fixed vanishing envelope.  This condition controls only the deterministic primitive expression; asymptotic band validity still requires the separately displayed remainder-event and feasible-score failure probabilities to vanish.
